subject: Joint POC: Acme Advisory private listing & co-sell SLA / demo credits
messages:
From: Susan Lin <susan.lin@acmeadvisory.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmeadvisory.com, aws-partner@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Joint POC request + private listing / sandbox credits

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro at the alliance summit — Acme Advisory is excited to run a joint POC with Redwood focused on low-latency inference for our enterprise customers. High level asks from our side: 

- Private listing (privatelist) so we can demo to healthcare pilot customers under our AWS account
- Sandbox/demo credits (2 months, 100K token equivalent) and two dedicated seats for our engineers
- A co-sell SLA promise for the sales cycle (target response SLA for leads and an escalation path)
- SOC2 evidence (summary report or attest) and basic network diagram for our security review

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a high-level architecture slide. Procurement is copied because we will need a short PO or MOU to approve the credits and the pilot terms. Can you confirm who on your side owns privatelist intake and what evidence we should expect? Also please include any DocuSign or HubSpot links you want us to use.

Best,
Susan Lin
Partnerships Lead, Acme Advisory

Attachment: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx
Attachment: POC-Architecture-Diagram.pdf

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lin <susan.lin@acmeadvisory.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, aws-partner@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint POC request + private listing / sandbox credits

Hi Susan — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Quick triage and proposed next steps: 

1) Private listing intake: Karhtik (cc'd) is our partner-marketplace technical lead and will own the privatelist eligibility checklist. Karthik — can you confirm the minimal evidence for a health-care-facing private listing (SOC2, dataflow diagram, support SLOs)?

2) Demo credits & sandbox access: We can allocate an initial 60-day POC credit pool and two sandbox seats. Ben will follow up with quota numbers and a draft PO flow. Ben — do we need a signed MOU to provision the credits or is a PO sufficient?

3) Co-sell SLA & escalation: High-level we can commit to a joint lead routing workflow (AWS channel + Redwood CS) and a 24-hour response target for inbound co-sell leads during the POC. I want to confirm legal escalation triage obligations before we promise an SLA beyond that.

4) Evidence: We can provide the SOC2 report summary and a redacted network diagram. I'll attach the standard evidence packet and a short checklist for privatelist. Expect a follow-up with DocuSign links for the credit MOU by EOD Wednesday.

Next steps: Karthik to post checklist, Ben to propose credit PO flow, Marissa to send evidence packet and DocuSign. Susan — are there any calendar constraints next week for a 30-minute technical intake with your engineering leads?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Alliances Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: credit sizing + PO process for Acme POC

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal note before I reply to procurement.

- Proposed credit allocation: 100,000 token-equivalent (60 days), two sandbox seats with role-based permissions. Cost is covered under the partner promo pool; I'll flag the chargeback to Alliances budget code.
- PO vs MOU: For credit provisioning we require a signed MOU for promotional credits (legal needs it for audit). Procurement can issue a PO for any paid work beyond credits. I will draft a one-page MOU (template: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xyz) and attach it to the DocuSign packet.
- Privatelist evidence: For healthcare pilots we need SOC2 Type II summary, dataflow diagram, and a support contact with escalation hours. Karthik — can you produce a minimal evidence packet and a sample privatelist metadata file by EOD Thu?

I'll coordinate with Solutions Ops to reserve two sandbox seats and create temporary credentials. Also suggest we include an explicit roll-off date and a conversion path if Acme wants to convert to reserved capacity (Dedicated) post-POC.

Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

Hi Susan / procurement team / AWS partner — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming agreed items and next steps so everyone has a single source of truth: 

Agreed:
- Redwood will provision a 60-day POC credit pool equivalent to 100,000 tokens and 2 sandbox seats for Acme (provisioning will begin once the MOU is executed).
- Redwood will start privatelist intake and will provide a short evidence packet (SOC2 summary, redacted network diagram, support SLOs) by Wed 29 May 2029.
- Co-sell routing: during the POC, inbound co-sell leads will be routed via AWS Partner lead flow and triaged within 24 hours by Redwood Sales/CS. Detailed contact list will be added to the HubSpot deal.
- Conversion path: we will include a recommended path to convert the POC to a Dedicated offering with estimated committed capacity and pricing.

- Ben Carter (Redwood): draft one-page MOU and DocuSign packet by Tue 28 May 2029; will also provision sandbox seats after MOU executes.
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood): privatelist intake checklist and evidence packet by Wed 29 May 2029; will post JIRA-OPS-452 for tracking.
- Susan / Acme Procurement: review MOU and return signed DocuSign or a PO; procurement clarifications requested around invoicing cadence.

Attachments & links:
